pl_impact.label: Shipping P&L impact
pl_impact.footnote: (LD revenue + tax savings) minus LD carrier cost, vs (warehouse revenue minus warehouse cost). Use the switch button to compare frames: revenue retained, net cost delta.

revenue_retained.label: Revenue retained vs warehouse pricing
revenue_retained.footnote: Customer was charged {{ldCharged}} for LD vs {{whRate}} if shipped warehouse. The delta is retained revenue.

net_cost_delta.label: Net cost delta
net_cost_delta.footnote: LD carrier cost minus warehouse counterfactual cost. Negative means saving.

chart.title: Net P&L by month, LD vs warehouse counterfactual
chart.subtitle: Profit per channel after costs · {{range}}

table.title: Per-city breakdown
table.subtitle: Click any row to drill down to orders

noLdUsage.title: No local delivery activity yet
noLdUsage.body: Once you dispatch your first LD route, this panel will show what your shipping P&L looks like vs warehouse delivery.

noCarrier.title_teaser: You could be saving about {{amount}} per month
noCarrier.body_teaser: Based on your last 90 days of orders, switching eligible {{city}} deliveries to LD instead of warehouse would have generated an estimated {{plDelta}} in extra shipping P&L. Connect a carrier so we can confirm with real quotes.
noCarrier.title_conservative: Connect a warehouse carrier to see savings
noCarrier.body_conservative: To compare LD costs against warehouse shipping, connect a carrier so we can quote the same orders both ways.
noCarrier.teaserDisclaimer: Estimate based on Intelipost speculative quotes against your historical orders. Numbers refine once a carrier is connected.

authFailed.title: Intelipost authentication failed
authFailed.body: The API rejected your stored credentials. Showing data from the last successful sync ({{date}}).

partial.title: {{uncovered}} of {{total}} orders couldn't be quoted ({{coverage}}% coverage)
partial.body: The carrier returned errors for some addresses, likely out-of-zone or malformed. Numbers below cover the {{covered}} quoted orders.

insufficientCoverage.title: Insufficient data to compute savings
insufficientCoverage.body: Less than {{threshold}}% of orders could be quoted in this period. Retry uncovered orders to view savings.

disabled.title: Local Delivery analytics is off
disabled.body: Enable the analytics panel from Settings to start tracking LD shipping P&L.

states.drilldownEmpty: No orders in this city for the selected period.

overrides.title: Edit overrides
overrides.intro: Manual flat warehouse cost per location (used when carrier integration is unavailable, or to override the carrier number for a specific location). Tax savings apply to LD orders to that city.
overrides.warehouseCostHeading: Warehouse cost per order, by location

enable.label: Local Delivery analytics
enable.description: Beta. Shows LD shipping P&L vs warehouse counterfactual. Requires Intelipost (or another carrier) for accurate numbers.
